name: Interval Run
summary: A running workout alternating structured bouts of high-intensity running with lower-intensity recovery periods.

setup: Select an open running track, road, trail, or treadmill.
Perform a thorough warm-up consisting of easy jogging and dynamic mobility drills.
steps: Accelerate smoothly to your target interval speed, driving with the arms and striking beneath your center of mass.
Sustain the high-intensity running pace for the prescribed interval duration or distance.
Decelerate under control into an easy jog or walk to recover for the planned rest period.
Repeat the work-to-rest cycle for the target number of repetitions before finishing with an easy cool-down.
instructions.breathing: Maintain a steady, rhythmic breathing pattern synchronized with your stride cadence.
cues: Stay tall with a slight forward lean from the ankles
Drive knees forward and strike beneath your hips
Keep shoulders relaxed and pump your arms rhythmically

common_faults.fault: Sprinting too fast on the first rep and failing to maintain pace across later intervals.
common_faults.correction: Target a consistent, sustainable pace based on the intended interval duration rather than an all-out sprint.

common_faults.fault: Overstriding with a heavy heel strike far in front of the center of mass.
common_faults.correction: Increase step turnover and aim for feet to land directly beneath the hips.

precautions: Ensure appropriate footwear and run on an even, safe surface.
Discontinue if experiencing acute sharp pain in the lower extremities or chest discomfort.
